categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research, development, production, and sales of superfine fiber synthetic leather (超纤革). The company operates in a single industry segment focused on manufacturing and selling synthetic leather products. Main product categories include superfine fiber suede leather, superfine fiber glossy leather, and superfine fiber base cloth, which are widely applied in footwear, furniture, automotive interiors, sports equipment, and other industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes island-type (海岛型) superfine fiber technology as its core manufacturing method. Key technologies include PA6/PE blended island-type superfine fiber production, water-based polyurethane coating technology, water-reduced superfine leather technology, and eco-friendly production processes. The company has obtained 16 invention patents and 13 utility model patents, and participates in drafting 31 national and industry standards. Advanced production equipment enables high-speed, high-precision manufacturing with stable product consistency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves diverse downstream industries including footwear manufacturers, furniture and home furnishing companies, automotive interior suppliers, sports equipment manufacturers, and apparel companies. Major customers include international brands such as LV, CLARKS, UA, ZARA, ECCO, and domestic brands like Anta, 361°, and Aokang. The company's products are applied in casual shoes, labor protection shoes, sports shoes, sofas, automotive interiors, and various other consumer products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Changyi, Shandong Province. Domestically, it has significant market presence in East China (华东地区) and South China (华南地区) regions. Internationally, the company exports to Europe, Americas, and Southeast Asia. In 2024, domestic sales accounted for approximately 60.45% of revenue while international exports represented 39.55% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the synthetic leather supply chain. It sources raw materials (primarily polyurethane and superfine fibers) from suppliers, manufactures finished synthetic leather products, and sells directly to downstream manufacturers and distributors who incorporate the materials into consumer products. The company maintains a vertically integrated production system with in-house manufacturing capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technological innovation and product development. Key R&D initiatives include developing eco-friendly products using recycled and bio-based materials, water-based polyurethane technology, low-solvent production processes, and specialized products for specific applications (labor protection, sports equipment, children's products). The company maintains dedicated R&D facilities and invested 4.24% of revenue in R&D during 2024, with 90 R&D personnel representing 16.7% of total workforce.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of synthetic leather products to manufacturers and distributors. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of goods, which occurs upon customer receipt and confirmation for domestic sales, or upon export customs clearance for international sales. The company employs a make-to-order production model based on customer demand forecasts and specific orders. In 2024, direct sales accounted for 67.71% of revenue while distribution channels represented 32.29%.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of China's largest superfine fiber synthetic leather manufacturers and is recognized as a leader in the 'China Superfine Fiber Industry Base.' The company maintains competitive advantages through superior product quality, advanced technology, and strong customer relationships. While specific competitors are not named in the report, the company competes in the synthetic leather industry against other domestic and international manufacturers, with differentiation based on product quality, technical innovation, and customer service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 373.4 million yuan, representing 13.41% growth from 329.2 million yuan in 2023. Net profit recovered to 8.4 million yuan in 2024 from a loss of 7.9 million yuan in 2023. Total assets reached 683.4 million yuan at year-end 2024. The company has experienced revenue fluctuations, with 2022 revenue of 464.4 million yuan, indicating cyclical market conditions. The company maintains a solid equity base of 626.5 million yuan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior product quality, environmental sustainability, and technical innovation as core value propositions. Products feature excellent wear resistance, breathability, and aesthetic qualities comparable to or exceeding natural leather. The company holds the 'China Ecological Superfine Fiber Synthetic Leather' certification trademark and has received numerous awards including the National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class). Differentiation is achieved through eco-friendly production processes, diverse product portfolio serving multiple industries, and strong technical support for customers. The company positions itself as a reliable supplier offering stable quality, continuous innovation, and comprehensive customer service.
